verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is an open-source Python library that runs as a plain object or embedded in any environment (web, terminal, voice, background queue) with model-agnostic providers, and its observability (Logfire) is explicitly optional rather than required, meaning no mandatory vendor platform dependency for running agents. missing for 10: explicit self-hosted deployment guide/architecture docs, and independent hands-on confirmation that a production agent was run fully off-vendor infrastructure.
